title: Best Website Builder 2026: 5 builders tested with the same 8-page site
description: Squarespace, Wix, Webflow, Shopify, Carrd — same 8-page small business site on each. Time to publish, mobile responsiveness, SEO defaults, export portability.
lede: Five website builders. Same 8-page small business site. We built each, measured publish time, mobile rendering, SEO defaults, and which let you export your design.
methodology: Built same 8-page site (Home, About, Services, Portfolio, Blog list, Blog post, Contact, Pricing). Tracked: time to publish, mobile Lighthouse score, SEO meta defaults, export options, monthly cost.

sections.heading: Time to publish
paragraphs: Hours signup to published 8-page site: Squarespace 3 hrs, Wix 4 hrs (AI generator to 1 hr but design quality drops), Webflow 8 hrs (steepest curve), Shopify 5 hrs (e-commerce-first slows non-shop), Carrd 2 hrs.
Squarespace fastest because templates make design decisions for you. Webflow takes longest — truly designer-grade, closer to learning a design tool than using a builder.

sections.heading: Mobile + SEO
paragraphs: Lighthouse mobile (out of 100): Squarespace 78, Wix 65, Webflow 88 (best — clean output), Shopify 75, Carrd 92 (minimal overhead).

SEO defaults (meta, schema, sitemap, robots.txt): All 5 generate sitemaps + robots.txt. Squarespace and Webflow best default meta handling. Wix improved 2024. Shopify SEO is e-commerce-tuned. Carrd fewer knobs but sensible defaults.

sections.heading: Lock-in vs export
paragraphs: Export options: Webflow exports clean HTML/CSS/JS (unique). Others platform-locked. Migrating away requires manual rebuild.
Domain portability: All 5 allow custom domains. None of the locked platforms let you take your design — only your domain transfers.

faqs.a: Squarespace for design-focused sites where templates do the work. Wix for max flexibility / drag-and-drop. Squarespace cleaner; Wix more flexible at cost of consistency.
Yes if you want designer control + export portability. No if you want simple drag-and-drop. Webflow takes 1-2 weeks to learn; payoff is professional-grade output.
Not optimal. Shopify is e-commerce-first; non-product pages are afterthoughts. Use Shopify when products are primary; use Squarespace/Wix/Webflow for content-first.
Carrd for personal sites, link-in-bio, single-page presence. For multi-page, use Squarespace/Wix/Webflow. Carrd at $19/year is the cheapest serious option.

squarespace-builder.review: Squarespace is the right pick for design-focused sites where templates do the heavy lifting. Apple-like aesthetic, best e-commerce features outside Shopify on higher tiers, integrated scheduling and email marketing.

wix-builder.review: Wix is the right pick for maximum design flexibility. AI website generator produces sites in minutes (quality varies). Largest template library (900+). Wix Studio for designer control. Free tier with branding.

webflow-builder.review: Webflow is the right pick for designer-level control with clean code output. CSS-level visual editing, exports HTML/CSS/JS for self-hosting. Learning curve real but output professional-grade.

shopify-builder.review: Shopify is the right pick for e-commerce-first sites. Native payment processing, broad app ecosystem (10,000+ apps), product schema SEO. Not ideal for content-first sites.

carrd-single-page.review: Carrd is the right pick for personal sites, link-in-bio, single-page presence. $19/year unlocks all features (custom domain, forms, embeds). Cleanest Lighthouse scores. Not for multi-page sites.

offerNotes.squarespace-builder: Sign up at squarespace.com — 14-day free trial.
offerNotes.wix-builder: Sign up at wix.com — free tier with Wix branding. Paid from $16/mo.
offerNotes.webflow-builder: Sign up at webflow.com — free designer tier. Site hosting from $14/mo.
offerNotes.shopify-builder: Sign up at shopify.com — 3-day free trial, then $1/mo for 3 months.
offerNotes.carrd-single-page: Sign up at carrd.co — free tier. Pro at $19/year.
